edit.description: the at-most-once drop is one helper, taken by the stake and by the wait locks
`WaitLock.release` takes that drop, so its doc's claim to the stake's shape is true again
a wait lock released twice over a later holder's file

summary: `WaitLock.release` unlinks unconditionally while its doc claims the tip claim's shape, so a second release deletes a later holder's lock

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: a wait lock released a second time removes nothing, through the same drop the stake hands out rather than a second spelling of it
tests: a wait lock released a second time leaves a later holder's lock file standing
pins: a wait lock released once removes the file it created
notes: Per note A-RELEASED-CLAIM-NEVER-UNLINKS-A-LATER-HOLDERS. `WaitLock.release`'s doc (`src/waitLock.ts`) says "the same shape the tip claim's release carries"; since the stake gained its guard the two have parted, and the body is the bare `unlinkSync` that guard was added to fix. No caller double-releases a wait lock today, so this is the latent half of the same defect.
